'''Referee Reprints''' is the 1st virtual expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on 19 November 2008. The set consists of 31 cards, of which there are 29 unique titles.

*2 [[:Category:Doorway (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Doorway]]
*8 [[:Category:Event (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Event]]
*15 [[:Category:Incident (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Incident]]
*4 [[:Category:Interrupt (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Interrupt]]
*2 [[:Category:Objective (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Objective]]

==NOTE==

The set was initially released with a copyright line "VIRTUAL REPRINT PROVIDED BY THE CONTINUING COMMITTE". The set was later reissued with the new copyright line "NOT ENDORSED BY CBS OR PARAMOUNT PICTURES".
